description: Provenance of the vendored Fermix wire contracts. The canonical files live in the fermix repository under apps/fermix_core/priv/; this tree is a byte-identical copy pinned by CHECKSUMS.txt. scripts/verify_protocol_contract.sh asserts the two agree, and --source <fermix-checkout> byte-compares against upstream.

contracts.name: management
contracts.provenance_note: Re-vendored on 2026-11-02 at 6a747236 on dev; origin carries it, so committed_upstream is true. Since a7b938e2 (Always On's move back): on a linked desktop, on's Details offers move_back (Move back to this Mac, no needs, no confirm), and once pressed the move back leads the desktop's screen: creating while it connects (cancel), ready once the server holds it (move_now needing recovery_passphrase, its confirm built on the desktop, cancel among the alternatives), moving with the step in hand as progress, undone (try_again, cancel) and problem return_failed; where a server Fermix created stopped answering and this computer keeps a copy of its snapshots, the alternatives add restore_here (needs recovery_passphrase, a confirm saying what is lost), with the copy's date and when the server was last seen among the lines; back on this computer as the primary, problem server_retired offers delete_server and learn_more, and from a server of the owner's own the notice back:<epoch>; the action enums gain move_back and restore_here and the problem kinds server_retired and return_failed; home.enroll.withdraw takes kind (provisioned, the default, or manual); home.status adds update_ceiling (a string or null, optional); ready's sentence says Fermix can move back; the home.status goldens carry update_ceiling, on carries move_back and problem restore_here with its two lines; computer_use.permissions.get adds the optional platform, and on Linux display_server and rows, with a Linux success golden and a compatibility golden for an answer from before them; fields a daemon adds to a method after its minimum are optional and move neither the version nor the minimum. 101 methods, 90 at minimum 2. Protocol 2 on the 1 to 2 window, unchanged. Re-vendored on 2026-11-01 at a7b938e2 on dev; origin carries it, so committed_upstream is true. Unchanged since e1b7cbbb.

contracts.name: companion
contracts.provenance_note: Re-vendored on 2026-11-02 at 6a747236 on dev; origin carries it, so committed_upstream is true. Unchanged since a7b938e2. Re-vendored on 2026-11-01 at a7b938e2 on dev; origin carries it, so committed_upstream is true. Since e1b7cbbb, companion protocol 7 on the {6, 7} window: every server_hello carries commands, the engine's slash commands as the phone's caps.commands names them; the owner's connection, while the media store runs, is also named attachments {dir, max_bytes}, the inbox at FERMIX_HOME/companion/inbox and the largest file it takes; attach_file {attach_id, kind, mime, size_bytes, sha256, name?} hands over the file the app wrote at dir/attach_id, answered attach_status {attach_id, status: present} or request_failed with the engine's sentence and attach_id, the daemon removing the file before it answers and the app never removing one; a msg from a version 7 owner connection names held files in attach_ids, its text may be blank, its user row carries their media_refs, and an attach id the daemon no longer holds is accepted then refused with client_msg_id.
